DROP PROCEDURE [EDS].[SP_EDS_CUSTOMER_DIM]

EXECUTE [EDS].[SP_EDS_CUSTOMER_DIM] '2023-09-05'

SELECT 
OTD.TASK_NAME,OTR.PROCESS_DATE,OTR.STATUS_ID
FROM OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY OTD
LEFT JOIN OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
ON OTD.TASK_NAME=OTR.TASK_NAME
AND PROCESS_DATE='2023-10-10'
WHERE 
DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME='TSK_EDS_CUSTOMER_DIM'
